title: Location of Taxila
subject: Geography
caption: Map showing the location of ancient Taxila in modern Pakistan with nearby landmarks.
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background that pinpoints the ancient city of Taxila (Takshshila) in present‑day Pakistan with a red dot and label. The map includes surrounding features such as Islamabad to the south, the Indus River, the Khyber Pass, Peshawar, the Grand Trunk Road, and nearby archaeological sites Sirkap and Jaulian, all clearly labelled. A north arrow, scale bar, and legend are also shown, providing context for the location.
